# IrinaVFX

> Ordinary UI controls that react like anime: squash and overshoot on springs, and drawn effects (smoke, impact bursts, slashes, splashes) with manga sound-effect lettering, on one canvas over the page. Each is one plain script that registers a custom element: no dependencies, no build step, no other files to fetch. MIT licensed.

Live gallery: https://dayy4dev.github.io/irina-vfx/
Source: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx

## Drop-in components

Each is one plain script that registers a custom element. Load it with a script tag, not as a module. Do not rewrite or split the file. Each file carries a copy of the shared core; the first one loaded sets window.IrinaVFX and the rest reuse it, so any mix shares one canvas and one loop.

- [Button](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/button/button.js): A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. `<irina-button>`: <irina-button>Confirm</irina-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/button/README.md)
- [Toggle](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/toggle/toggle.js): A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). `<irina-toggle>`: <irina-toggle label="Notifications"></irina-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/toggle/README.md)
- [Slider](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/slider/slider.js): A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. `<irina-slider>`: <irina-slider value="30" label="Volume"></irina-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/slider/README.md)
- [Checkbox](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/checkbox/checkbox.js): A checkbox that slashes: crescents swing round the box, crystals fly, the tick draws itself, and ズザッ lands in dotted letters. `<irina-checkbox>`: <irina-checkbox>Remember me</irina-checkbox>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/checkbox/README.md)
- [Radio](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/radio/radio.js): A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. `<irina-radio>`: <irina-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></irina-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/radio/README.md)
- [Input](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/input/input.js): A text field that kicks up a puff of dust from the caret on every key. `<irina-input>`: <irina-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></irina-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/input/README.md)
- [Tabs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/tabs/tabs.js): Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. `<irina-tabs>`: <irina-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></irina-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/tabs/README.md)
- [Progress](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/progress/progress.js): A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. `<irina-progress>`: <irina-progress label="Loading"></irina-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for irina:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/progress/README.md)
- [Rating](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/rating/rating.js): Five stars that pop in one after another, with wedges and a hollow ポン on the last; five gets a burst. `<irina-rating>`: <irina-rating label="Rating"></irina-rating>. Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/rating/README.md)
- [Toast](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/toast/toast.js): A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. `<irina-toast>`: Put <irina-toast></irina-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/toast/README.md)
- [Tooltip](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/tooltip/tooltip.js): A help button whose hint springs out like a speech bubble, with puffs and a hollow カチッ. `<irina-tooltip>`: <irina-tooltip text="Helpful hint!"></irina-tooltip>. Opens on hover, focus and tap; Escape closes it. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/tooltip/README.md)
- [Select](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/select/select.js): A dropdown select whose trigger squashes, menu springs open with puffs, and picking an option lands a glint and カチッ. `<irina-select>`: <irina-select label="Weapon"><option value="katana">Katana</option></irina-select>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/select/README.md)
- [Dialog](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/dialog/dialog.js): A modal dialog that springs into view with speed lines, smoke puffs, shards, and ドン!. `<irina-dialog>`: Put <irina-dialog heading="Title">...</irina-dialog> and call el.show(). Closes on Escape, backdrop click, or close button. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/dialog/README.md)
- [Accordion](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/accordion/accordion.js): A collapsible panel whose header squashes, body springs open, and bottom corners land with smoke puffs and ポン. `<irina-accordion>`: <irina-accordion heading="Details">...</irina-accordion>. Read el.open and listen for change. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/accordion/README.md)
- [Counter](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/counter/counter.js): A like/upvote counter button that pops with a burst, shards, glint, and ポン when activated. `<irina-counter>`: <irina-counter count="12" label="Like"></irina-counter>. Read el.count and el.active; listen for change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/counter/README.md)
- [Drawer](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/drawer/drawer.js): A slide-over drawer/sheet that streaks in with speed lines, lands in dust with ズザッ, and slides away when dismissed. `<irina-drawer>`: Put <irina-drawer heading="Menu">...</irina-drawer> and call el.show(). Supports side="right" or side="left". [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/drawer/README.md)
- [Badge](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/badge/badge.js): A manga stamp badge that slams onto the page with concentration lines, puffs, a sparkle, and custom SFX lettering. `<irina-badge>`: <irina-badge interactive variant="accent" sfx="BAM!">Trigger Stamp</irina-badge>. Call el.stamp() to slam it. [Docs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/blob/main/badge/README.md)

Install any one with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add dayy4dev/irina-vfx/NAME`, where NAME is button, toggle, slider, checkbox, radio, input, tabs, progress, rating, toast, tooltip, select, dialog, accordion, counter, drawer, badge. The file lands in `public/irina-vfx/`.

Colours are --ir-* CSS variables; a page's own :root values win. Effects stay active by default even when prefers-reduced-motion is set (override via window.IrinaVFX.respectReducedMotion = true).

## The skill

- [irina-vfx skill](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/skills/irina-vfx/SKILL.md): the workflow and rules these were made by. Install with `npx skills add dayy4dev/irina-vfx`.
- [core.js](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/skills/irina-vfx/core.js): the shared core (Spring, the effects, the lettering, the palette, a custom-element base class with one clock).
- [starter.html](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/skills/irina-vfx/starter.html): the smallest whole example, a like button.
- [look.mjs](https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx/skills/irina-vfx/look.mjs): stops the clock, steps a reaction to chosen moments and saves the frames side by side.
